item.title: This week in biopharma records — Nov 16–22, 2026
item.description:
This week in biopharma records (Nov 16–22, 2026)
• 23 new industry Phase 3 trials, largest first: – Novartis: Pacibekitug · Myocardial Infarction (PINNACLE-MI) – Hoffmann-La Roche: Fenebrutinib · Multiple Sclerosis • 14 industry Phase 3 trials posted results – Bayer: Asundexian · Prevention of Ischemic Stroke (OCEANIC-STROKE) – GlaxoSmithKline: Bepirovirsen · Chronic Hepatitis B • 9 industry Phase 3 trials marked terminated, suspended or withdrawn – Bellus Health: BLU-5937 · Cough (CALM-2) – Xenon: Azetukalner · Major Depressive Disorder (X-NOVA2) • 8 original FDA approvals (NDA/BLA), 4 with priority review: – Infilbray (venglustat, Genzyme Corp A Sanofi Co) – Lembaz (adrabetadex, Mandos Llc) – Livsayis (cemdisiran, Regeneron Pharmaceuticals) – Nelkarmi (neladalkib, Nuvalent) • 1 Class I drug recall
Every item links to its official record: https://fedor-i.github.io/OpenBioNews/brief/2026-11-22.html
Built automatically from ClinicalTrials.gov, openFDA, the Federal Register and SEC EDGAR with OpenBioNews (free, open source). Check the record before relying on an item.
